verdict.summary: The finite-angle construction, centered log-attention rank 9, dot-softmax rank bound 8, exact-real overlap reproduction, chosen-dephased bound 4, and both signed full-40 CE comparisons are mathematically valid. verdict.review_basis: Independent algebra and direct reading of the complete pinned source inline in the packet, plus the two listed local inputs. No native forward or checker execution.

algebra.dimensions: One batch element; 40 relation rows and 10 valid tokens; C=I_10-1_10 1_10^T/10 acts on token columns.
algebra.kernel: theta_i=(-9+2i)pi/10, i=0,...,9. First ten effect rows use the same grid. K_ri=cos^2((theta_i-theta_r)/2)+epsilon=A+B cos(2pi(i-r)/10), A=1/2+epsilon, B=1/2. For epsilon=1/1000000, 10A=5.00001, min K=epsilon and max K=1+epsilon. The remaining 30 rows repeat row 0.
algebra.normalization: The grid sum of exp(i theta_i) is zero, hence every row sum is exactly 10A. Alpha=K/(10A), so (log Alpha)C=(log K)C. This uses the source token normalizer, rather than a normalization across the 40 relations.
algebra.factorization: Delta=sqrt(A^2-B^2)>0, t=B/(A+Delta) in (0,1), C0=(A+Delta)/2. Then C0(1+t^2)=A and 2C0t=B, giving K(x)=C0(1+t exp(ix))(1+t exp(-ix)).
algebra.fourier_series: log K(x)=log C0+sum over nonzero integers m of a_m exp(imx), where a_m=(-1)^(|m|+1)t^|m|/|m|. Absolute convergence follows from t<1, and justifies exchanging the sampled finite DFT sum with the infinite series.
algebra.alias_non_cancellation: For j=1,...,9, lambda_j=10 sum_{k in Z} a_(j+10k), up to the immaterial opposite DFT index convention. No term has index zero. Since 10 is even, |j+10k| has the parity of j; every term has sign (-1)^(j+1), and the term m=j exists. Consequently all nine lambda_j are nonzero. Their reality also follows from the symmetric circulant kernel.
algebra.rank_conclusion: Right centering annihilates exactly the constant Fourier direction and retains all nine other directions. The first 10 by 10 block therefore has centered log rank exactly 9. Appending 30 repeated rows preserves this rank, and ten centered token columns impose the matching global upper bound 9.
algebra.nonzero_margin: For d_j=min(j,10-j), |lambda_j|>=10 t^d_j/d_j>=2t^5>0. This is an analytic nonzero bound, not a numerical rank threshold. A small enough real-valued perturbation preserves rank 9 by continuity; no bound on native floating-point implementation error was measured here.
algebra.dot_softmax_bound: For any finite real query and key tensors on these 10 valid tokens, S=Q K^T/sqrt(8) has rank at most 8, even with source key biases and role coordinates. Rowwise log softmax gives log Alpha=S-c 1^T, hence (log Alpha)C=SC and rank<=8. Masks require restricting to valid columns before logarithms; padded zeros have no finite logarithm.
algebra.ordinary_rank_distinction: K_ri=A+B cos(theta_r)cos(theta_i)+B sin(theta_r)sin(theta_i), so ordinary unlogged attention rank is at most 3 (indeed exactly 3 for the first ten grid rows). High centered log rank is therefore compatible with low ordinary attention rank. No conclusion follows about rank of final class probabilities or classification performance.

native_source_correspondence.shapes_and_indices: Use h shape [1,10,1024], roles [1,10,4], and an all-true Boolean mask [1,10]. prepare.weight has shape [12,1028]. Its [0,0]=1 with all other weights and biases zero reads only h channel 0. Flattened output index 0 reshapes to [layer=0,wire=0,RY=0] under shape [2,3,2]. Source effect has shape [40,2,3,2], with only [r,0,0,0] nonzero. Role channels 1024 through 1027 have zero selector coefficients.
native_source_correspondence.finite_values: All raw angle parameters and h channel 0 obey absolute value <=atanh(9/10)=log(19)/2, approximately 1.47222. Trigonometric h coordinates and indicator coordinates have absolute value <=1. All other coefficients are zero or one, and queries have unit norm. Every intended angle has absolute value <=0.9pi, strictly within the pi*tanh range.
native_source_correspondence.circuit_order: Only the first layer's first-wire RY acts nontrivially. All RZ angles and all other RY angles vanish. The two ordered CNOT rings then form one common basis permutation U for every prepared state and effect. With wire 0 as MSB, the first ring maps |100> to |011>, the second maps that to |010>, and both preserve |000>. The source gather is each CNOT's own inverse permutation, so it implements the same ordered CNOT action. Thus psi_i=cos(theta_i/2)|000>+sin(theta_i/2)|010>, and phi_r has the same form with theta_r.
native_source_correspondence.overlap_and_readout: The source phi-conjugate/psi contraction is cos((theta_i-theta_r)/2); abs-square yields the kernel probability. The common U is harmless for overlap and, being a basis permutation, also yields the stated dephased probabilities. EPS is added before token masking and normalization. The source permits all 40 effects to repeat; they are separate binary measurements, with no joint-POVM completeness constraint.
native_source_correspondence.arithmetic_caveat: The exact grid, rational epsilon, exact trigonometric identities, exact unit norms and exact cross-mode equality are mathematical statements. Native math.pi, tanh, torch trigonometry, normalization, complex arithmetic and the uniform control's .float() use finite precision; the listed rational values and exact equality are not bitwise claims. A literal treatment of math.pi as its binary constant can be accommodated in the mathematical map by using raw atanh(theta_i/math.pi_source) for exact target angles; that adjustment still leaves finite parameters strictly inside the allowed range. This review neither runs nor certifies that adjustment in native tensors.
native_source_correspondence.checker_scope: The supplied checker computes elementary scalar identities and hashes/AST facts when executed; it contains no native RMEA forward. Its finite alias loop checks a parity pattern for sampled k only. The complete infinite alias proof is the mathematical argument above, rather than an exhaustive computation. The checker was read, not executed.

real_overlap.parameters: For the control key Linear(1028,8), set weight[0,1]=weight[1,2]=1, all remaining weights and biases zero. Set query[r]=(cos(theta_r/2),sin(theta_r/2),0,...,0). Key and query norms are exactly one in real arithmetic, so source F.normalize leaves them unchanged.
real_overlap.identity: The real normalized dot product equals cos(theta_i/2)cos(theta_r/2)+sin(theta_i/2)sin(theta_r/2)=cos((theta_i-theta_r)/2). Squaring, adding the same epsilon and applying the same valid-token mask reproduces every entry of the 40 by 10 native quantum attention exactly in real arithmetic. Using the same value map, decoder and class bias also reproduces logits.
real_overlap.limitation: This is a common-input head-API witness on engineered features containing both atanh(theta/pi) and the corresponding half-angle cosine/sine. It establishes neither general equality of the two function classes on arbitrary inputs nor realization by the frozen encoder. RZ phases and quantum-exclusive expressivity are absent from this witness.

chosen_dephased.identity: Basis-permuted population overlap is cos^2(theta_i/2)cos^2(theta_r/2)+sin^2(theta_i/2)sin^2(theta_r/2)=(1+cos(theta_i)cos(theta_r))/2. Thus raw D_ri=A+B cos(theta_r)cos(theta_i), with positive entries and the same 10A row sum.
chosen_dephased.column_subspace: Token cosines take exactly the five distinct values {-cos(pi/10),-cos(3pi/10),0,cos(3pi/10),cos(pi/10)}. Column pairs are (0,9),(1,8),(2,7),(3,6),(4,5). Taking entrywise logarithms preserves equality within each pair. Every centered row lies in the five-dimensional pair-constant subspace intersected with 1-perp, which has dimension four; hence centered log rank <=4.
chosen_dephased.limitation: The bound uses this angle grid and this single-rotation, common-basis-permutation witness. It is not a bound for the general native dephased head. Its ordinary unlogged attention rank is at most 2.
